heading: Gold, Silver, Platinum Import Tax Relief Ends: What It Means for Buyers
tldr: The Indian government has withdrawn the upfront IGST exemption for banks and nominated agencies importing precious metals.
This means importers now pay IGST at the time of import, impacting their working capital.
A new 3% customs levy has also been introduced on these precious metal imports since April 1, 2026.
This additional 3% customs levy is a direct cost increase for importers, likely passed on to consumers.
Buyers of physical gold, silver, and platinum jewellery or articles could see slightly higher prices domestically.
caption:
Heads up, gold and silver lovers! The government has made changes to how precious metals are imported. This means companies bringing in gold, silver, and platinum now pay more tax upfront. Ultimately, this could mean you might see slightly higher prices when you buy jewellery or coins. Want to understand why and by how much? Read the full article to know more.
